summary: Modern one bedroom apartment · Available June 2024 · Private balcony · Jesmond Vale
description:
My Property Box are delighted to offer to the Lettings Market this modern one bedroom apartment at the popular Deneside Court, Jesmond. Nestled away in a quiet corner of Jesmond Vale, the apartment offers spacious living space with convenient access to the rest of Jesmond and also the rest of Newcastle. Modern fixtures & fittings throughout as well as a private balcony.

Available early June 2024, furnished. To arrange a viewing, contact MPB today and speak to the Lettings Team.
